subject: Request: Data-exit playbook & vendor clearance (country-level subprocessors)

Subject: Request: Data-exit playbook & vendor clearance (country-level subprocessors)

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our procurement diligence we need a short, operational "data exit playbook" and a current list of your subprocessors broken down by country and role. Specifically can you provide:

- A CSV manifest of all subprocessors (name, country of processing, function, contact, encryption at rest/in-transit notes)
- A concise playbook describing how FinVault would: (a) export customer data on demand, (b) terminate/transfer processing in a country, and (c) revoke access keys / credential rotation timeline
- Any regional egress restrictions or dependencies (e.g., third-party caches, analytics relays) that affect EU/UK/APAC customers

We prefer the manifest in a machine-readable CSV and a 1–2 page PDF for the playbook. If you have a standard DPA addendum for subprocessors please attach it.

We are targeting a legal review next week; would appreciate if you can get the CSV + playbook over by EOD Monday (2026-11-15).

Thanks —

Subject: Re: Request: Data-exit playbook & vendor clearance (country-level subprocessors)

Hi Kimberly —

Attaching: vendor_subprocessors_manifest.csv (CSV, 14KB) and a short draft of the playbook (initial version). Key notes inline below.

Quick highlights from the manifest:
- Primary processing locations: US (primary), Ireland (EU backup), Singapore (APAC regional processing)
- Caching/edge providers listed as "EdgePay Relay" (EdgePay is a subcontractor for transient cache; see row 17)
- Encryption: All production volumes encrypted at rest with AES-256; TLS 1.2+ in transit. KMS provider: KeyForge (US, limited EU key residency option).

Data exit playbook (summary):
1) Export request: Customer files a keyed export request via our portal. FinVault prepares a time-limited secure transfer (SFTP or signed URL) within 72 hours for standard exports. For high-volume dumps we offer AWS Snowball-style export coordination.
2) Credential revocation: Upon contract termination we rotate service credentials within 24 hours (most internal service tokens) and take 7-day revocation across all third-party dashboards (a small number require vendor support to complete).
3) Onshore transfer option: Where required, we can route EU traffic to Ireland-resident processing and provision onshore key storage (additional fee applies).

Limitations / regional caveats:
- Singapore operations currently rely on a telemetry relay hosted in Hong Kong; we can isolate telemetry on request but it requires a 4–6 week change window.
- Some analytics snapshots are stored by an analytics subcontractor for 30 days. We can shorten retention on request but need a 30-day SLA to enact.

I can run a quick internal confirmation to add copy of our standard DPA addendum and SOC 2 snapshot. Would you like those attached to the manifest now or after your legal takes a first pass?

Thanks,
Samantha Lowe
Head of Integrations
FinVault Ltd.
samantha@finvault.com

Attachment: data_exit_playbook_v1.pdf (PDF, 88KB)

2) For KMS KeyForge, please confirm whether keys for EU/UK customers are ever backed up to US regions and whether KeyForge supports dedicated HSMs for customer-specific keys.

If Sam can confirm those points briefly we can include the answers in the DPA addendum request.

From: Samantha Lowe <samantha@finvault.com>

Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: Data-exit playbook & vendor clearance (country-level subprocessors)

Hi Ben —

Thanks — answers below inline. Quoting your lines for clarity:

> 1) EdgePay Relay persistence?
EdgePay Relay is configured for transient caching only. Default TTLs are 60–120 seconds for API payloads. We do maintain short-term diagnostic logs (request IDs, anonymized headers) with a 7-day retention stored in EdgePay's EU cluster when operating for EU customers. No customer payloads are persisted to the relay beyond the TTL.

> 2) KeyForge backups for EU keys?
KeyForge offers a regional key segregation feature. For customers that require EU-only key residency, keys are provisioned in the Ireland cluster and are not backed up to US regions. We also support a dedicated HSM offering (added cost) which ensures a single-tenant key lifecycle (let us know if you need pricing).

I attached an excerpted SOC 2 snapshot and our standard DPA addendum in the Drive link below for legal review.

Attachment: FinVault_SOC2_excerpt.pdf (PDF, 56KB)
Drive: https://drive.finvault.com/rdw/attachments/finvault-soc2-excerpt

Happy to hop on a short call if useful.

—Sam
